title: 34.4Mbps 1.56Tbps/W DEFLATE Decompression Accelerator Featuring Block-Adaptive Huffman Decoder
relevance: Hardware DEFLATE decoder with block-adaptive Huffman tables. Uses dual-ALU approach that evaluates pairs of code lengths with opportunistic skipping. Shows 34% throughput improvement from adaptive techniques.

title: A 43.3 bit/cycle Inflate Accelerator Featuring Static-Dynamic Huffman Decoder with Multiple Checkpoints
relevance: Uses multiple checkpoints across blocks to enable speculative decode of subsequent blocks. Directly implements block-level prediction in hardware.

title: Faster zlib/DEFLATE decompression on the Apple M1 (and x86)
relevance: Includes NEON-accelerated table building and table-building optimizations. Shows table build as ~1% of total time, but this increases for small blocks.
